label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Priya,

I’m replying just to you. First: I’m not throwing you under the bus with Greg. I’ll tell him what happened and that we’re already fixing it. He’ll be mad no matter what — I’ll handle him before his 4pm. This isn’t about making you the story.

I’m not going to pretend I’m calm. Brazos is 186k ARR over three years, I’ve been working it since February, and it’s my biggest deal of the year. I may have also told my wife we’d finally do the Big Bend trip off this commission, so yeah. But that’s my pressure, not something for you to carry. I remember you staying until 9pm in September rebuilding their demo env when the route import broke. One copy-paste mistake doesn’t change that. The questionnaire library is a mess and nobody owns it — that’s not just on you. You’ve been great on this account, and I’m not going to let one bad answer define that.

I know you’re sorry. I don’t need you to fall on a sword; I need you sharp on the fix. Here’s what I need tonight: fix Q14 with the real Type I status and the Jan 31 date — Type II audit in progress, window closes Jan 31, report expected March — and send it to me first, not Dana. I’ll review it before it goes anywhere.

Thursday at 2 is the call with Dana and their legal. Marcus from security can join and speak to the actual status and timeline. I need you on that call too. Marcus also says we can give them a bridge letter from the auditor, so we’ll use that.

This is fixable if we’re honest and fast. Dana seems strict but fair. Please don’t beat yourself up. We’re fixing this together.

Jordan
